item.title: Deadly Earthquake Hits Freedonia, Killing Over 100
item.description: A powerful earthquake struck Freedonia's coast, killing at least 120 people, according to government officials.

item.title: Fed Lowers Rates, Citing Softer Job Market
item.description: The Federal Reserve cut interest rates by a quarter point, its first reduction of the year.

item.title: Senate Passes Infrastructure Bill After Weeks of Talks
item.description: The 68-30 vote sends the measure to the House.

item.title: Study Finds New Drug Slows Early Alzheimer's Progression
item.description: Researchers reported in a peer-reviewed trial of 1,800 patients that the drug slowed cognitive decline by 27 percent over 18 months. Experts cautioned that side effects remain a concern.
